QuestInfo.name: Corruption of Morals: Strong Stone Goblin
QuestInfo.0: #p9000072# at the #b#m950100000##k looks very upset. What could be the problem? Talk to #b#p9000072##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p9000072# says that the influx of tourists has corrupted the morals and culture of the village. Have you seen the way those #o8144007# beasts dress?! They must be stopped. Talk to #b#p9000075##k to enter the Goblin Cave.\n\n#o8144007##r #a105881##k
QuestInfo.2: You cleansed the area of some seriously bad scenery, but #p9000072# thinks they'll be back in #bjust 1 hour#k. Come back later to save everybody from some ugly sights.

0.0: How could this be?! How could this have happened in the #m950100000#? This is all because of #p9000078#, whose idea was to develop #m950100000# into a tourist attraction. Look at all those tourists who've come at his beckoning! What? You want to know what I'm talking about?
0.1: All those tourists are corrupting the morals and culture of the holy #m950100000#! I have evidence... Have you SEEN a #o8144007# lately? I blush just to look at one! Something must be done!

yes.0: Ah, a tourist with some sense! Finally! Go defeat #r200#k of those shamefully-dressed creatures. Oh, and do it without staring directly at a #r#o8144007##k. I wouldn't want you to have to see something so shameful! Talk to #b#p9000075##k to enter the Goblin Cave.

no.0: Fine. I'll just have to tell #p9000078# to stop letting visitors into the temple altogether then. I hope you're happy.

1.0: Thank you, oh thank you! Now the town's back on the straight and narrow!

yes.0: But once corruption has entered a place, it can't be rid of so easily. Next time I see a #o8144007#, I'll bet it'll be unclothed again! Could you come back in #b1 hour#k to teach them another lesson?

mob.0: I know it's intolerable to be in the presence of such moral bankruptcy, but I need you to defeat #r200#k of those shamefully-dressed #r#o8144007##k creatures. Talk to #b#p9000075##k to enter the Goblin Cave.
